name: High Sorcerer Andromath
summary: At Stormwind’s Wizard’s Sanctum, promising Alliance mages are summoned to the tower’s summit. Andromath works among the kingdom’s foremost archmages beyond ruined Dalaran.

sections.title: Summons to the Tower
sections.body: Jennea Cannon, the apprentice coordinator in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, sends promising casters to the summit of the Wizard’s Sanctum. High Sorcerer Andromath, one of the southern kingdoms’ most senior active practitioners of the arcane, has asked to meet magi ready for greater responsibilities.

sections.title: A Master Outside Dalaran
sections.body: Dalaran’s magocracy was ruined in the Third War, and its surviving wizards are busy rebuilding. Without easy access to the Violet Citadel’s libraries, the Alliance relies on senior archmages in Stormwind to study ancient threats and guide research into shadowy, forbidden arts.

faq.answer: At the top of Stormwind’s Wizard’s Sanctum, High Sorcerer Andromath is a senior mage. Beyond Dalaran, his peers count him among the world’s most powerful and knowledgeable spellcasters.

faq.q: Where can I find High Sorcerer Andromath?
faq.answer: Andromath is at the summit of the Wizard’s Sanctum, the spiraling tower in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon send me to see him?
faq.answer: Jennea Cannon sends promising casters who have outgrown basic instruction to Andromath for higher counsel and specialized, hazardous research.

faq.q: What does Andromath need help with?
faq.answer: Andromath calls on capable mages to investigate dark arcane secrets, including retrieving the dangerous historical volume Ur’s Treatise on Shadow Magic.

faq.q: Why is Dalaran described as 'locked away'?
faq.answer: Jennea’s words reflect how withdrawn the Kirin Tor have been since the Third War. After the Scourge and Burning Legion devastated Dalaran, its surviving wizards turned inward to rebuild, leaving few involved in outside affairs.

faq.q: Is this quest exclusive to mages?
faq.answer: Yes. The summons belongs to the training path for Alliance mages advancing their craft.

angles.text: As a mage, you move from routine spellcraft exercises with Jennea Cannon to dangerous, specialized lore alongside one of Stormwind’s foremost archmages.
As an Alliance member, you depend on Stormwind’s Sanctum to train mages and counter supernatural threats while Dalaran’s surviving magi rebuild their ruined city.
